description: This is a parchment card. Follow its instructions, and when you are done with it, destroy it. For all intents and purposes, this is not considered a card at all. Especially not when you have destroyed it. All 4 cards you can choose will let you discover new cards. Whichever you choose, you will miss out on cards that the others offer. This decision will shape the future of your kingdom, but don't worry about not knowing exactly what the cards referenced are; all 4 cards are good in different ways, you cannot make a bad call.
